before: Exactly one new obstacle is spawned every 1 second while the game state is `playing`.
after: Exactly one new obstacle is spawned every 0.75 seconds while the game state is `playing`.

before: The 1-second spawn interval remains fixed and does not change according to elapsed time, score, or survival duration.
after: The 0.75-second spawn interval remains fixed and does not change according to elapsed time, score, or survival duration.

before: The obstacle spawn timer advances continuously. Exactly one obstacle is created whenever the fixed 1-second spawn interval is reached, and each active obstacle moves downward at 200 px/s.
after: The obstacle spawn timer advances continuously. Exactly one obstacle is created whenever the fixed 0.75-second spawn interval is reached, and each active obstacle moves downward at 200 px/s.
